name: Orleans Parish, LA
findings: Orleans Parish has 2,628 nonprofit organizations. 1,029 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 825 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Orleans Parish has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Orleans Parish list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 69 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Arts and cultural organizations stand out for public events
observations.text: 63 arts and cultural organizations here list public events, compared with about 15 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 63 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do arts and cultural organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?
